weighting: E1 equal category, equal source within category, equal pair within source; split pair weight equally between endpoints
standardization: training-endpoint weighted population standard deviation, floor 1e-5
patch_complete_fold: head has all A, P, C, F exact scores; rank within each original class-specific 64-candidate set before intersecting
consensus_m1_marker: selected in at least 3 of 5 folds; fold panels mark their own 51 selected heads
